provenance.module_origin: Existing b66_common_initial seed; source declarations must be rechecked by genuine compiler before freeze

battery.port_and_ageing: Keep exact admitted seed module laws and coefficients; no independent invented vendor data

pv.orientations: All co-oriented; preserve seed effective body-frame panel normal and per-module efficiency/rating

camera.orientation: Same effective body-frame optical normal, payload and RF service in all designs

designs.control_pair: D1_BALANCED; only battery placement and necessarily derived wire geometry/mass change

common_rules: CORE/equipment block is a physical uniform cuboid mass carrier, not an empty outer bus. Overall spacecraft extents are derived from all installed components.
Mount/envelope/collision admission is mandatory; only geometry-refusal repairs before science freeze, with intent diff and no outcome tuning.
Support/equipment mass covered once by declared CORE lump; no free additional structures, fabricated shell or false FEM/strength claim.
Same orbit, calendar/Sun phase, requests, contact assumptions, controller, actuator, camera, RF service, initial SOC fraction and temperatures for all designs.
Same conductor material, cross-section, connector and slack rules; transform genuine local ports and author routes before any mission result.
Retain supported existing thermal nodes and declared contact graph; disclose fixed external forcing. Position alone does not create thermal conductance or shadowing.
Recompute part mass*cp, declared exposed areas/emissivity, route mass*cp and wire heat using existing exact owners. No fictitious compensating cp.
Use normal existing ASSUMED ageing, not accelerated ageing presented as reality. Preserve and report actual inherited coefficients.
D1/D4 is the placement control; other variants compare entire engineering configurations and do not isolate a single cause.
Zero credit or a physical failure is a valid design outcome. Do not tune hardware, guards or initial energy after results to manufacture winners.
Full 90-day jobs remain source/root/policy bound. Runtime concurrency changes do not alter physical inputs, reset work, or migrate checkpoints.
outputs: expired requests and typed actual refusals
minimum/final energy and selected unmet load
terminal voltage/current extrema where genuinely recorded
part/harness/total mass, COM and full inertia tensor
runtime CPU/wall/RSS/disk and exact restart/continuation evidence
